22999-the-ffolliots-of-redmarley.description: A book by L. Allen Harker. "I should think you didn't--but look here, if it's true of a bad name, mustn't it be equally true of a good one? Why, it's argument, it's logic, that is. Call a boy Eloquent and ten to one he'll _be_ eloquent, don't you see?"

arxiv-1807-05274.title: Sparse semiparametric canonical correlation analysis for data of mixed types
arxiv-1807-05274.creator: Grace Yoon, Raymond J. Carroll and Irina Gaynanova
arxiv-1807-05274.description: Abstract Canonical correlation analysis investigates linear relationships between two sets of variables, but often works poorly on modern data sets due to high-dimensionality and mixed data types such as continuous, binary and zero-inflated. To overcome these challenges, we propose a semiparametric approach for sparse canonical correlation analysis based on Gaussian copula.

arxiv-1808-09206.title: Matching Cells
arxiv-1808-09206.description: Abstract . A (complete) matching of the cells of a triangulated manifold can be thought as a combinatorial or discrete version of a nonsingular vector field. This note gives several methods for constructing such matchings. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification M.S.C. 2010: 05C70, 05E45, 37C10, 37F20, 57Q15 Gaël Meigniez August 9, 2026 1.

arxiv-2105-05665.creator: Fayyazuddin
arxiv-2105-05665.description: Abstract The nonleptonic decays Λ b → Σ c ∗ ⁣ − ​ π + , Ξ c ∗ 0 ​ K 0 \Lambda_{b}\rightarrow\Sigma_{c}^{*-}\pi^{+},\Xi_{c}^{*0}K^{0} and Λ b → Δ 0 ​ D 0 , Σ ∗ ⁣ − ​ D 0 + \Lambda_{b}\rightarrow\Delta^{0}D^{0},\Sigma^{*-}D_{0}^{+} are studied.

arxiv-2209-00131.title: On the incorrect use of Carlisle’s method for dichotomous variables
arxiv-2209-00131.creator: Daniel V. Tausk
arxiv-2209-00131.description: Abstract . In 2017, J. B. Carlisle has proposed a method for fraud detection in randomized controlled trials based on a comparison of reported baseline data between treatment groups. While Carlisle has only used the method for continuous variables, some authors have recently employed a naive adaption of the method for dichotomous variables.

arxiv-2210-07701.title: Compressed Sensing of Compton Profiles for Fermi Surface Reconstruction: Concept and Implementation
arxiv-2210-07701.creator: Junya Otsuki, Kazuyoshi Yoshimi, Yoshinori Nakanishi-Ohno, Michael Sekania, Liviu Chioncel, Masaichiro Mizumaki
arxiv-2210-07701.description: Abstract Compton scattering is a well-established technique that can provide detailed information about electronic states in solids. Making use of the principle of tomography, it is possible to determine the Fermi surface from sets of Compton-scattering data with different scattering axes. Practical applications, however, are limited due to long acquisition time required for measuring along enough number of scattering directions.

arxiv-2304-10606.title: Geometric conditions to obtain Anosov geodesic flow in non-compact manifolds Thanks: Keywords : Anosov geodesic flow, Jacobi field, focal points, warped product. Thanks: Mathematics Subject Classification (2010) : 37D40, 53C20.
arxiv-2304-10606.creator: Alexander Cantoral, Sergio Romaña
arxiv-2304-10606.description: Abstract . Let ( M , g ) (M,g) be a complete Riemannian manifold without focal points and curvature bounded below. We prove that when the average of the sectional curvature in tangent planes along geodesics is negative and uniformly away from zero, then the geodesic flow is of Anosov type.

arxiv-2308-04405.title: Nonlinear parametric models of viscoelastic fluid flows Thanks: e-mail: akaptano@umd.edu Thanks: e-mail: kutz@uw.edu Thanks: e-mail: sbrunton@uw.edu
arxiv-2308-04405.creator: Cassio M. Oishi
arxiv-2308-04405.description: Abstract Reduced-order models have been widely adopted in fluid mechanics, particularly in the context of Newtonian fluid flows. These models offer the ability to predict complex dynamics, such as instabilities and oscillations, at a considerably reduced computational cost. In contrast, the reduced-order modeling of non-Newtonian viscoelastic fluid flows remains relatively unexplored.

arxiv-2312-01007.title: A Hypergraph-Based Approach to Recommend Online Resources in a Library
arxiv-2312-01007.creator: Debashish Roy, Rajarshi Roy Chowdhury
arxiv-2312-01007.description: Abstract When users in a digital library read or browse online resources, it generates an immense amount of data. If the underlying system can recommend items, such as books and journals, to the users, it will help them to find the related items.

arxiv-2312-02716.title: The anomalous Lagrangian in ChPT at NNLO
arxiv-2312-02716.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by *. The anomalous Lagrangian in mesonic Chiral Perturbation Theory, of odd intrinsic parity, is determined to next-to-next-to-leading order thereby completing the order p 8 p^{8} Lagrangian. A schematic view of its construction with the MINIBAR package for Mathematica is presented and the final operator count is discussed for a general number of light quark flavours as well as for the physical cases N f = 2 , 3 N_{f}=2,3 .

arxiv-2411-02828.title: Synchronous manipulation of nuclear spins via boron vacancy centers in hexagonal boron nitride
arxiv-2411-02828.creator: Fattah Sakuldee, Mehdi Abdi
arxiv-2411-02828.description: Abstract We develop a method for entangling operations on nuclear spins surrounding a negatively charged boron vacancy (VB-center) point defect in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). To this end, we propose to employ the electron spin of a VB-center as a control qubit.

arxiv-2412-16589.title: Improving FIM Code Completions via Context & Curriculum Based Learning Conference: Proceedings of the Eighteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining; March 10–14, 2025; Hannover, Germany Proceedings of the Eighteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (
arxiv-2412-16589.creator: Hitesh Sagtani, Rishabh Mehrotra, Beyang Liu
arxiv-2412-16589.description: Abstract . Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) models play a vital role in code completion tasks, leveraging both prefix and suffix context to provide more accurate and contextually relevant suggestions. This paper presents approaches to improve FIM code completion while addressing the challenge of maintaining low latency for real-time coding assistance.

arxiv-2511-09086.title: A 5D concept for space-time optimal control problems with application to simplified Carreau flow
arxiv-2511-09086.creator: S. Beuchler, B. Endtmayer, U. Langer, A. Schafelner, T. Wick
arxiv-2511-09086.description: Abstract 1 Status Optimization problems for Non-Newtonian fluids, particularly those containing nanoparticles, arise in many applications such as in medicine, engineering, and optics. This work is related to the last topic, namely optics, which is intensively investigated in the cluster of excellence PhoenixD 4 ; 11 .

pmc-11430156.title: Adapting Child Development Assessment Tools to the Rural Indian Context
pmc-11430156.creator: Riti Chandrashekhar, Baldeep K Dhaliwal, Ananya Rattani, Rajeev Seth, Suba Guruprasad, Himani Khanna, Anita Shet
pmc-11430156.description: Background: Child development assessment tests serve many purposes, including educational placement, identifying cognitive weaknesses, and initiating early interventions. Much of the research associated with developmental testing has been conducted in high-income countries, offering limited guidance on adapting these tests to other settings.

pmc-11437030.title: Impact of microvascular decompression on wall shear stress in responsible arteries in trigeminal neuralgia and hemifacial spasm
pmc-11437030.creator: Toru Satoh, Yoichi Sawada, Isao Date, Takao Yasuhara, Kentaro Fujii
pmc-11437030.description: Microvascular decompression (MVD) has proven efficacy in trigeminal neuralgia (TN) and hemifacial spasm (HFS). This study utilized computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to investigate the impact of MVD on wall shear stress (WSS) of responsible arteries (RAs) at the neurovascular contact (NVC). A total of 21 cases (10 TN, 11 HFS) were analyzed, involving RAs at NVC validated through intraoperative photographs.

pmc-11632259.title: Workflow of the zero‐fluoro pulsed field ablation
pmc-11632259.creator: Shu Hirata, Koichi Nagashima, Ryuta Watanabe, Yuji Wakamatsu, Moyuru Hirata, Sayaka Kurokawa, Naoto Otsuka, Masanaru Sawada, Yasuo Okumura
pmc-11632259.description: BackgroundZero‐fluoroscopic pulsed field ablation (PFA) is the next step in advancing pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) for atrial fibrillation (AF).MethodsA workflow incorporating a variable‐loop circular PFA catheter, intracardiac echocardiography (ICE), and a visualized sheath was applied to 15 paroxysmal AF patients.

pmc-11671799.title: Voice of a woman: influence of interaction partner characteristics on cycle dependent vocal changes in women
pmc-11671799.creator: Janek S. Lobmaier, Wilhelm K. Klatt, Stefan R. Schweinberger
pmc-11671799.description: IntroductionResearch has shown that women’s vocal characteristics change during the menstrual cycle. Further, evidence suggests that individuals alter their voices depending on the context, such as when speaking to a highly attractive person, or a person with a different social status.

pmc-12801076.title: Arthroscopic Centralization During Meniscal Allograft Transplantation
pmc-12801076.creator: Saagar Dhanjani, Tim Wang
pmc-12801076.description: Pathologic extrusion of the meniscus, defined as displacement of more than 3 mm beyond the tibial plateau border, can disrupt tibiofemoral contact mechanics by reducing hoop strain resistance and increasing articular cartilage contact pressure. Meniscal extrusion following meniscal allograft transplantation is well documented, with studies reporting extrusion rates of over 40%.

pmc-12979788.title: A micro-CT–integrated 3D simulation framework reveals fluid transport mechanisms and void dynamics in root canal fillings
pmc-12979788.creator: Amir Raoof, Maryam Raoof, Hossein Fathi, Behdad Pouran, Reza Derakhshani
pmc-12979788.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A micro-CT–integrated three-dimensional simulation-assisted leakage analysis methodology (3D-SALAM) was developed to address the long-standing limitations of destructive, poorly reproducible leakage tests traditionally used to evaluate the sealing performance of root canal fillings. Despite decades of research, the long-term stability of root canal fillings remains uncertain because existing in vitro models fail to capture the complex, three-dimensional transport of fluids through micro-void networks.

pmc-13206702.title: Impaired P4HA1-Driven Hydroxyproline Formation Mediates Scleral Collagen Disruption in Form-Deprivation Myopia
pmc-13206702.creator: Jing Li, Jiaojiao Feng, Yibo Han, Xiaoqi Gong, Shuhan Li, Guodong Tang, Yuxi Liu, Junru Wang, Xiaoyun Dong, Yixue Yin, Yunxiao Xie, Hongsheng Bi, Jike Song
pmc-13206702.description: PurposeScleral extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling is a hallmark of myopia progression, yet its metabolic drivers remain poorly defined. This study investigated whether disruption of arginine-proline metabolism—specifically impaired P4HA1-mediated proline hydroxylation—contributes to hydroxyproline deficiency, collagen disorganization, and axial elongation in form-deprivation myopia (FDM).MethodsMonocular FDM was induced in guinea pigs for two weeks.

pmc-13476578.title: Projected lives saved and economic value of mRNA cancer immunotherapies in the United States
pmc-13476578.creator: Chad R Wells, Abhishek Pandey, Carolyn Bawden, Yang Ye, Bilori Bilori, Lilia Potter-Schwartz, Lamia Ayaz, Seyed M Moghadas, Jeffrey P Townsend, Meagan C Fitzpatrick, Alison P Galvani
pmc-13476578.description: SummaryMessenger RNA (mRNA) technology helped prevent millions of deaths during the COVID-19 pandemic and is emerging as a promising cancer treatment modality. Early-phase trials suggest mRNA immunotherapies can improve overall and recurrence-free survival. However, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has terminated investment in this transformative platform.

pmc-13501669.creator: Dula Dessalegn Bosho, Yonas Deressa Guracho, Selamawit Worku Asmare, Behailu Terefe Tesfaye, Diriba Dereje Olana, Tesema Etefa Birhanu

pmc-13527492.title: Synergising latent profile analysis and network analysis to elucidate the relationships among emotion dysregulation, post-traumatic stress disorder, dissociation, psychosis, and affective symptoms in individuals with trauma and severe mental illness
pmc-13527492.creator: Jianlin Liu, Celeste Minn Tan, Adela-Maria Isvoranu, Sacha Epskamp, Yoke Boon Tan, Rachel Hsiao Shen Tan, Sherilyn Shi Hui Chang, Vanessa Ai Ling Seet, Phern Chern Tor, Yu Wei Lee, Charmaine Tang, Nisha Chandwani, Swapna Verma, Mythily Subramaniam
pmc-13527492.description: BackgroundTrauma exposure and emotion dysregulation are transdiagnostic risk factors for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and severe mental disorders (e.g., depression, and schizophrenia spectrum disorders). The present study elucidated the latent profiles and interrelationships between emotion dysregulation and psychopathology (PTSD, dissociation, psychosis, and affective symptoms) in a trauma-exposed severe mental illness population.

pmc-13574852.title: Sonazoid-enhanced ultrasound for preoperative localization and characterization of sentinel lymph nodes in patients with cutaneous melanoma
pmc-13574852.creator: Binbin Jiang, Liqi Sun, Lu Si, Jiayong Liu, Chuanliang Cui, Kun Yan, Shanshan Yin
pmc-13574852.description: ObjectiveAccurate sentinel lymph node (SLN) identification is essential for the staging of cutaneous melanoma. Contrast-enhanced ultrasound using Sonazoid (Sonazoid-CEUS), which is based on a perfluorobutane microbubble contrast agent with reticuloendothelial uptake properties, was evaluated for SLN detection in patients with stage Ib–II melanoma.

pmc-13660823.title: Tailoring Symmetry Breaking in Engineered van der Waals Superlattices
pmc-13660823.creator: Keda Jin, Lennart Klebl, Zachary A. H. Goodwin, Junting Zhao, Felix Lüpke, Dante M. Kennes, Jose Martinez‐Castro, Markus Ternes
pmc-13660823.description: Superlattice engineering in van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures (e.g., by moiré engineering) provides a powerful platform for designing electronic bands and realizing correlated and topological quantum phenomena.Here, we pioneer a scheme to tailor superpotentials based on intrinsic substrate electronic orders.

pmc-13677632.title: A comprehensive analysis of the association of psychological profiling and sagittal balance parameters with neck pain in a non-deformity cervical spondylosis population: A prospective two-centers cross-sectional study
pmc-13677632.creator: Marco Battistelli, Sofia Vannuccini, Massimo Benenati, Mario Muselli, Nicola Montano, Massimiliano Visocchi, Gabriele Capo, Carlo Brembilla, Maurizio Fornari, Simona Gaudino, Francesco Doglietto, Filippo Maria Polli, Daniela Pia Rosaria Chieffo
pmc-13677632.description: Purpose to comprehensively identify determining factors of perceived neck pain in a non-deformity population, integrating psychological and sagittal balance parameters.Methods a cross-sectional study of prospectively collected data was conducted on patients admitted for cervical spondylosis at two tertiary university hospitals between April 2024 and August 2025. Eligible cases were retrieved from the PANDA Registry.
